cards.title: Coherent single-qubit over-rotation
cards.role: Defines the exact coherent error used in Fig. 5(a).

checks.reason: Equation and theta are present in raw/paper.txt around Eq. (9).
Because (X+Z)^2=2I, the closed-form exponential is unitary; the test checks U dagger U=I.

cards.title: Pauli-twirled coherent error
cards.role: Defines the Clifford-compatible approximation compared with the coherent model.

checks.reason: Equation (10) states the I/X/Z Pauli channel and p approximately 0.0243.

cards.title: Two-Kraus leakage channel and generalized-Pauli twirl
cards.role: Generates every transition and Pauli weight printed in Table III.

checks.reason: Equation (12), p_t=0.2, the sector labels, and all printed Table III values are explicit in the paper.
The independently constructed K0/K1 channel is CPTP for p_t=0.2.
Blockwise Pauli coefficients reproduce transition probabilities 0.95/0.05/0.10/0.90 and every printed nonidentity weight.
The printed error values sum to p_tr and become normalized only after division by p_tr, so they are joint rather than conditional weights.

cards.numerical_form: Blockwise Pauli expansion of K0 and K1 with source-sector dimension normalization
open_questions: Table III labels the listed values p_err|tr although the numbers are joint transition-and-error weights; fresh review must adjudicate the header.

cards.title: Thermal heating Lindbladian
cards.role: Generates the five-sector transition matrix in Figure 10.

checks.reason: Gamma_h=0.2, n_th=1, five sectors and one idling interval are printed with Figure 10.
Every independently exponentiated transition column sums to one within 4.44e-16.
All 25 entries agree with the paper's printed five-decimal matrix within 1e-4; maximum difference is 5.29e-5.

cards.numerical_form: exp(L Delta t) applied to each diagonal sector basis state

cards.title: Transmon-CZ Hamiltonian and dissipative channel
cards.role: Defines the hardware-derived transmon channel used by the logical-error and threshold scans.

checks.reason: The paper prints the coupled-transmon Hamiltonian, jump operators, scan variable, code distances, rounds, and shot allocations.

cards.numerical_form: Integrate the finite-dimensional Lindblad generator for each CZ error channel, then compile independent Stim, XPauli-like, and full-state QEC samplers.
open_questions: The exact commercial circuit schedule and sampler conversion are not published; an independent canonical implementation must declare any resulting convention cap.

cards.title: Neutral-atom Rydberg channel and threshold surface
cards.role: Defines the three physical noise axes used for the neutral-atom threshold surface.

checks.reason: The paper gives the driven-level model, decay channels, three scan axes, code family, and threshold-surface interpretation.

cards.numerical_form: Integrate the printed Rydberg pulse channel, construct declared barycentric scan rays, and fit thresholds for independent Clifford and leakage-aware representations.
open_questions: The precise 15 barycentric ray coordinates are not tabulated, so exact marker locations require author metadata; a declared grid can still test the scientific surface separation.

checks.reason: The paper prints the sector-to-error relation, Gamma_h interval, distance and round ranges, initial sector, truncation, shots, decoder, and fitted threshold.
